description: Vercel AI SDK v5 generateText with an Anthropic prompt marked for cache.
notes: Telemetry is enabled on the call. recordInputs and recordOutputs stay at their defaults, which record message content on spans. The Anthropic base URL already includes /v1, and the client appends /messages. The system message sets providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl to ephemeral. Scripted usage is input 2100, output 40, cache_read 1800, cache_write 200. The spans copy Anthropic's raw input_tokens of 100 and output_tokens of 40. Cache read and cache write are not usage attributes. Cache write is only in ai.response.providerMetadata, as anthropic.cacheCreationInputTokens and anthropic.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens. ai.response.timestamp is the process clock. Covers D113 (Vercel v5 + Anthropic exclusive input, cache write only in ai.response.providerMetadata).
